nodes.title: A quiet canvas
nodes.question: What should be visible while exploring the design?
nodes.answer: Use a canvas that shows the design tree. Show as little as possible to promote focus.
nodes.agentRecommendation: Keep question details in an on-demand panel.

nodes.title: Answer inside the UI
nodes.question: How should answers reach the agent?
nodes.answer: Prefer sending each UI answer directly into the existing Claude Code or Codex session, with the agent publishing the updated canvas artifact.
nodes.agentRecommendation: Bind the canvas to an explicit session ID and use a supported session transport. Keep a durable outbox and copy fallback when delivery is unavailable.

nodes.title: Invoke it as a skill
nodes.question: How should this experience be launched?
nodes.answer: Create a reusable skill. Do not use Lavish.
nodes.agentRecommendation: Bundle the canvas and a local bridge with the skill.

nodes.title: Details only on demand
nodes.question: Should clicking a node open a small answer panel?
nodes.agentRecommendation: Keep the canvas unobstructed until a question is selected.

nodes.title: Subtle question status
nodes.question: How should resolved questions and the current frontier be distinguished?
nodes.answer: A noticeable green checkmark and soft green fill for resolved nodes; amber frontier highlighting; no routine status text. Show small question IDs in each node so questions can be referenced.
nodes.agentRecommendation: Keep status visible through the checkmark and background treatment.

nodes.title: Revisit dependent answers
nodes.question: When you clarify an answer, should the agent revisit downstream decisions?
nodes.agentRecommendation: Preserve answers that still hold and mark potentially invalidated answers for review.

nodes.title: When the agent is away
nodes.question: Should replies remain queued when the agent is not listening?
nodes.agentRecommendation: Keep the reply and offer copy/paste, while clearly showing that the agent is not currently listening.

nodes.title: Resume the interview
nodes.question: Should a future invocation resume a matching session in the workspace?
nodes.agentRecommendation: Reuse its stable question IDs and settled answers.

nodes.title: Portable session files
nodes.question: Should export include unfinished drafts as well as settled answers?
nodes.agentRecommendation: Export the snapshot and unfinished drafts together so they can be recovered.
